uq_ideas_open_source.name: uq_ideas_open_source
uq_ideas_open_source.where: "ideas"."source_issue_key" IS NOT NULL AND "ideas"."state" NOT IN ('promoted','discarded') AND "ideas"."deleted_at" IS NULL

ideas_source_has_connection.name: ideas_source_has_connection
ideas_source_has_connection.value: "ideas"."source_issue_key" IS NULL OR "ideas"."source_connection_id" IS NOT NULL

ideas_promoted_has_connection.name: ideas_promoted_has_connection
ideas_promoted_has_connection.value: "ideas"."promoted_issue_key" IS NULL OR "ideas"."promoted_connection_id" IS NOT NULL

mail_links_issue_has_connection.name: mail_links_issue_has_connection
mail_links_issue_has_connection.value: "mail_links"."issue_key" IS NULL OR "mail_links"."connection_id" IS NOT NULL

mail_links_one_target.name: mail_links_one_target
mail_links_one_target.value: ("mail_links"."issue_key" IS NOT NULL) <> ("mail_links"."note_id" IS NOT NULL)

markdown_notes_issue_has_connection.name: markdown_notes_issue_has_connection
markdown_notes_issue_has_connection.value: "markdown_notes"."issue_key" IS NULL OR "markdown_notes"."connection_id" IS NOT NULL

planned_entries_issue_has_connection.name: planned_entries_issue_has_connection
planned_entries_issue_has_connection.value: "planned_entries"."issue_key" IS NULL OR "planned_entries"."connection_id" IS NOT NULL

planned_entries_work_has_issue.name: planned_entries_work_has_issue
planned_entries_work_has_issue.value: "planned_entries"."kind" <> 'work' OR ("planned_entries"."connection_id" IS NOT NULL AND "planned_entries"."issue_key" IS NOT NULL)

planned_entries_vacation_user_level.name: planned_entries_vacation_user_level
planned_entries_vacation_user_level.value: "planned_entries"."kind" <> 'vacation' OR ("planned_entries"."connection_id" IS NULL AND "planned_entries"."item_id" IS NULL AND "planned_entries"."issue_key" IS NULL)

todos_issue_has_connection.name: todos_issue_has_connection
todos_issue_has_connection.value: "todos"."issue_key" IS NULL OR "todos"."connection_id" IS NOT NULL
